sql:
SELECT NorthAmericaSeason, avg(daily_total) AS avg_daily_sales
FROM (
  SELECT d.NorthAmericaSeason AS NorthAmericaSeason, f.DateKey AS DateKey, sum(f.SalesAmount) AS daily_total
  FROM retail.FactOnlineSales f
  JOIN retail.DimDate d ON f.DateKey = d.DateKey
  GROUP BY d.NorthAmericaSeason, f.DateKey
)
GROUP BY NorthAmericaSeason
ORDER BY avg_daily_sales DESC
LIMIT 1
